deliberateDifferences: An explicitly selected trusted WebSocketConnector replaces Node callbacks; Stream/Sink backpressure and pull iteration keep no SDK event queue, within validated per-event and byte bounds.

Native WebSocket transport is a separate opt-in ws-transport feature with explicit direct socket/TLS configuration. HTTP transport proxy and CA configuration is never inherited; custom connectors preserve caller-owned network integration.

One absolute default60s operation/session deadline covers validation, queueing, authentication, upgrade and event consumption; handshake is also bounded15s and idle reads/writes30s. Explicit graceful cancellation has its own bounded500ms cleanup budget.
Dropping either split handle immediately releases the socket and concurrency permit. Partially sent cancellation retains Unknown remote outcome. No automatic replay or OAuth refresh is performed.
Native option bounds cap events16MiB and buffers64MiB; only peer close1000 is clean, and HTTP101 alone does not imply provider readiness.
Default native framing is qualified only for64-bit targets, uses patched tokio-websockets0.13.3, and requires Rust1.89; caller connectors remain available without the native adapter.
